title: Review and audit the closeout gate implementation
acceptanceCriteria: A review/audit task is linked as a blocker before sprint closeout.
Review evidence uses --kind review with passed outcome, or a forced gate bypass includes reason and comment.
No parent closeout proceeds without review/audit gate outcome in the agent summary.
Checkpoint outcome is recorded as a scoped commit or dirty-path reason code.
closedReason: Review/audit outcome recorded with passed review evidence; no repository changes were required for this evidence-only closeout.
